instrument_policy.spectral_noise: equal duration ending 1 s before P; quiet-window search
instrument_policy.preference: HH, EL, HG among usable records; independent of amplitude or KMA ML
instrument_policy.target_pair_exclusion: Sangju KS.BURB: unresolved co-located horizontal response discrepancy; both families excluded

policy.scale: Sheen, Kang & Rhie (2018), equations 5--6, station corrections zero
policy.amplitude: revised Wood-Anderson zero-to-peak mm; geometric mean of N/E peaks
policy.processing: demean, linear detrend, one 1-percent taper capped 5 s; regularized response to DISP, waterlevel=None, .1/.2/25/40 Hz prefilter; causal six-pole .5--10 Hz Butterworth; revised WA, no additional taper
policy.timing: origin+[hypocentral_km/4, hypocentral_km/2]; attenuation uses epicentral km
policy.noise: observed P+[ -6, -1 ] seconds, peak absolute amplitude
policy.picking: observed P probability >=.3; no theoretical-P rescued stations
policy.primary: median horizontal station ML; both N/E peak SNR>=3; >=3 stations; HH preferred then EL then HG; one observation per site; 10<=R_epi<=100 km
policy.comparison_quality: at least 5 horizontal stations, robust station scatter <=.35
policy.sensitivities: SNR2, H-preferred/V-fallback, all valid sensors incl HG, BB only, strict metadata, 40--100 km, epicentral timing, trimmed mean
policy.units: HH/EL must declare M/S; HG must declare M/S**2; unknown response units quarantined
policy.response: dated merged response override, historical master otherwise; coordinate check <=2 km; exclude KS.KWJU.HH and KS.SEJF.EL
policy.source_selection: KMA ML>=2 defines parent sample only; ML amplitudes/zero point/station corrections are not fitted to KMA or Mw
policy.overlap: full catalog M>=1.5 within 180 s and 50 km; exclude overlapping signal or pre-P noise; no quiet-window search
policy.published_calibration: published epicentral attenuation; 100-km aperture is narrower than original 10--600 km calibration; no independently fitted station terms

response_sources.policy: Exact channel and epoch; audited merged response first, dated NECIS current response second, historical master fallback; require station coordinate agreement within 2 km. HG permitted only with acceleration units. One record per site.
response_sources.limitations: An open historical epoch is not independent proof that the instrument stayed unchanged. The national response history has not received the full Haenam station audit.
